spells.description: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

spells.name: Unspeakable Horror
spells.description: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

spells.name: Paranoia
spells.description: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

passive.name: Living Forge
passive.description: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources.Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere.Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

spells.name: Volcanic Rupture
spells.description: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.

spells.name: Bellows Breath
spells.description: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.

spells.name: Searing Charge
spells.description: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.

spells.name: Call of the Forge God
spells.description: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.

passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

spells.name: Tough It Out
spells.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

passive.name: Mortal Will
passive.description: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

spells.name: Comet Spear
spells.description: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

spells.name: Shield Vault
spells.description: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

spells.name: Aegis Assault
spells.description: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

spells.name: Grand Starfall
spells.description: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

passive.name: Royal Privilege
passive.description: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
spells.description: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.

spells.name: Terrashape
spells.description: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.

spells.name: Audacity
spells.description: Qiyana dashes to an enemy, damaging them.

spells.name: Supreme Display of Talent
spells.description: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.

passive.name: Harrier
passive.description: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with Harrier. Quinn's first basic attack against Harrier targets will deal bonus physical damage.

spells.name: Blinding Assault
spells.description: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.

spells.name: Heightened Senses
spells.description: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.

spells.name: Vault
spells.description: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.

spells.name: Behind Enemy Lines
spells.description: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.  Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.

passive.name: Break the Mold
passive.description: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

spells.name: Shattering Strike
spells.description: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

spells.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
spells.description: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed.Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.

spells.name: Full Tilt
spells.description: Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed.Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Magnet Storm
spells.description: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

passive.name: Leverage
passive.description: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

spells.name: Handshake
spells.description: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.

spells.name: Bailout
spells.description: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.

spells.name: Loyalty Program
spells.description: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.

spells.name: Hostile Takeover
spells.description: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.

passive.name: Call of the Freljord
passive.description: Nunu increases the attack speed and Move Speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.

spells.name: Consume
spells.description: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

spells.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
spells.description: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it.  The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

spells.name: Snowball Barrage
spells.description: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies.  When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.description: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

passive.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
passive.description: When Pyke is hidden from enemies, he regenerates damage that he has recently taken from champions. Pyke also cannot gain extra Maximum Health from any source, and instead gains Bonus AD.

spells.name: Bone Skewer
spells.description: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.

spells.name: Ghostwater Dive
spells.description: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.

spells.name: Phantom Undertow
spells.description: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.

spells.name: Death From Below
spells.description: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.

passive.name: Iron Ambassador
passive.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

spells.name: Hammer Shock
spells.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

spells.name: Steadfast Presence
spells.description: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

spells.name: Keeper's Verdict
spells.description: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.description: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

spells.name: Frenzying Taunt
spells.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

spells.name: Soaring Slam
spells.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

passive.name: Junkyard Titan
passive.description: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

spells.name: Flamespitter
spells.description: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

spells.name: Scrap Shield
spells.description: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.

spells.name: Electro Harpoon
spells.description: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

spells.name: The Equalizer
spells.description: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

passive.name: Unseen Predator
passive.description: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

spells.name: Savagery
spells.description: Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.

spells.name: Battle Roar
spells.description: Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.

spells.name: Bola Strike
spells.description: Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration.Ferocity effect: roots the target.

spells.name: Thrill of the Hunt
spells.description: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

passive.name: Daredevil Impulse
passive.description: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

spells.name: Flair
spells.description: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

spells.name: Blade Whirl
spells.description: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.

spells.name: Wild Rush
spells.description: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.

spells.name: Inferno Trigger
spells.description: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

passive.name: Reign of Anger
passive.description: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

spells.name: Cull the Meek
spells.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.

spells.name: Ruthless Predator
spells.description: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Slice and Dice
spells.description: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

spells.name: Dominus
spells.description: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

passive.name: Backstab
passive.description: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal additional damage when striking from behind.

spells.name: Deceive
spells.description: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location.His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.

spells.name: Jack In The Box
spells.description: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Two-Shiv Poison
spells.description: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing their Move Speed. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target. The thrown Shiv deals bonus damage if the target is below 30% health.

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.description: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets).  Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.

passive.name: Scalemail
passive.description: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

spells.name: Emberstrike
spells.description: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

spells.name: Inferno Aegis
spells.description: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates.  While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

spells.name: Molten Burst
spells.description: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.description: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

passive.name: Threads of Vibration
passive.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

spells.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
spells.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

spells.name: Seismic Bastion
spells.description: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

spells.name: Ixtal's Impact
spells.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

spells.name: Impale
spells.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

passive.name: Noxious Slipstream
passive.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

spells.name: Poison Trail
spells.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

spells.name: Mega Adhesive
spells.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

spells.name: Fling
spells.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

spells.name: Insanity Potion
spells.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

spells.name: Achooo!
spells.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

spells.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
spells.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

spells.name: MMOOOMMMM!
spells.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

passive.name: Pit Grit
passive.description: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

spells.name: Knuckle Down
spells.description: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.

spells.name: Haymaker
spells.description: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

spells.name: Facebreaker
spells.description: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

spells.name: The Show Stopper
spells.description: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

spells.name: Death's Hand
spells.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

spells.name: Vision of Empire
spells.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

spells.name: Nevermove
spells.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

spells.name: Demonic Ascension
spells.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

passive.name: Absolution
passive.description: When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance. Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

spells.name: Piercing Darkness
spells.description: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.

spells.name: Last Embrace
spells.description: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.

spells.name: Curse of the Black Mist
spells.description: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.

spells.name: Dawning Shadow
spells.description: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.

passive.name: Runic Blade
passive.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

spells.name: Broken Wings
spells.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

spells.name: Ki Burst
spells.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

spells.name: Valor
spells.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

spells.name: Blade of the Exile
spells.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

passive.name: Fey Feathers
passive.description: Rakan periodically gains a shield.

spells.name: Gleaming Quill
spells.description: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.

spells.name: Grand Entrance
spells.description: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.

spells.name: Battle Dance
spells.description: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.

spells.name: The Quickness
spells.description: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.

passive.name: Ki Barrier
passive.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

spells.name: Twilight Assault
spells.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

spells.name: Spirit's Refuge
spells.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

spells.name: Stand United
spells.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.description: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.description: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.description: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

passive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
passive.description: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

spells.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
spells.description: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.

spells.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
spells.description: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

spells.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
spells.description: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.

spells.name: Void Rush
spells.description: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.

passive.name: Petricite Burst
passive.description: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

spells.name: Chain Lash
spells.description: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

spells.name: Kingslayer
spells.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

spells.name: Abscond / Abduct
spells.description: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

spells.name: Hijack
spells.description: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

passive.name: Power Chord
passive.description: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

spells.name: Hymn of Valor
spells.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

spells.name: Aria of Perseverance
spells.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

spells.name: Song of Celerity
spells.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

spells.name: Crescendo
spells.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

passive.name: Salvation
passive.description: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

spells.name: Starcall
spells.description: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

spells.name: Astral Infusion
spells.description: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

spells.name: Equinox
spells.description: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

passive.name: Rock Surfing
passive.description: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

spells.name: Threaded Volley
spells.description: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.

spells.name: Seismic Shove
spells.description: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

spells.name: Unraveled Earth
spells.description: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.

spells.name: Weaver's Wall
spells.description: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.

passive.name: Bravado
passive.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

spells.name: Starlight's Touch
spells.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.

spells.name: Bastion
spells.description: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.

spells.name: Cosmic Radiance
spells.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

spells.name: Mocking Shout
spells.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

spells.name: Spinning Slash
spells.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

spells.name: Undying Rage
spells.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

spells.name: Chomp
spells.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

spells.name: Frozen Domain
spells.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

spells.name: Pillar of Ice
spells.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

spells.name: Subjugate
spells.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

spells.name: Tumble
spells.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.description: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.description: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

passive.name: Loaded Dice
passive.description: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

spells.name: Wild Cards
spells.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

spells.name: Pick a Card
spells.description: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

spells.name: Stacked Deck
spells.description: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.

spells.name: Destiny
spells.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
passive.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

spells.name: Plasma Fission
spells.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.

spells.name: Void Rift
spells.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.

spells.name: Tectonic Disruption
spells.description: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.

spells.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
spells.description: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.

passive.name: Doom 'n Gloom
passive.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

spells.name: Mistral Bolt
spells.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

spells.name: Personal Space
spells.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

spells.name: Looming Darkness
spells.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

spells.name: Shadow Surge
spells.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

passive.name: Blast Shield
passive.description: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

spells.name: Vault Breaker
spells.description: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.

spells.name: Denting Blows
spells.description: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.

spells.name: Relentless Force
spells.description: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.

spells.name: Cease and Desist
spells.description: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

spells.name: Decimating Smash
spells.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

spells.name: Soul Furnace
spells.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

spells.name: Roar of the Slayer
spells.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

spells.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
spells.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

passive.name: Sovereign's Domination
passive.description: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

spells.name: Blade of the Ruined King
spells.description: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.

spells.name: Spectral Maw
spells.description: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.

spells.name: Harrowed Path
spells.description: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.

spells.name: Heartbreaker
spells.description: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.

passive.name: Glorious Evolution
passive.description: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. With every 100 Hex Fragments he obtains, Viktor permanently augments an active ability. After upgrading all of his basic abilities, he can gather 100 Hex Fragments to augment his ultimate ability.

spells.name: Siphon Power
spells.description: Viktor blasts an enemy unit with magic damage, which grants him a shield and empowers his next basic attack.Augment: Siphon Power's shield is increased by 60% and Viktor gains bonus move speed after casting the Ability.

spells.name: Gravity Field
spells.description: Viktor conjures a heavy gravitational field that slows enemies caught within its radius. Enemies who stay in the field for too long become stunned.Augment: Viktor's spells apply a slow to enemies.

spells.name: Hextech Ray
spells.description: Viktor uses his biomechanical arm to fire a Hextech Ray that cuts across the field in a line, dealing damage to all enemies in its path.Augment: An explosion follows in the Hextech Ray's wake, dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Arcane Storm
spells.description: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm on the field, dealing magic damage and interrupting enemy channels. The storm periodically does magic damage to all nearby enemies and can be redirected by Viktor.Augment: The Arcane Storm moves 25% faster, and whenever champions die after taking damage from it, the storm grows and increases in its duration.

passive.name: Draw a Bead
passive.description: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

spells.name: Rapid Fire
spells.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

spells.name: Rocket Jump
spells.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

spells.name: Explosive Charge
spells.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

spells.name: Buster Shot
spells.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

spells.name: Venom Cask
spells.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

spells.name: Contaminate
spells.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

spells.name: Dark Matter
spells.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

spells.name: Primordial Burst
spells.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

passive.name: Eternal Hunger
passive.description: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.

spells.name: Jaws of the Beast
spells.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

spells.name: Blood Hunt
spells.description: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.

spells.name: Primal Howl
spells.description: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

spells.name: Infinite Duress
spells.description: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.description: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Thundering Smash
spells.description: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

spells.name: Frenzied Maul
spells.description: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them.  Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.

spells.name: Sky Splitter
spells.description: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.

spells.name: Stormbringer
spells.description: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health.  Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

passive.name: Guerrilla Warfare
passive.description: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

spells.name: Blinding Dart
spells.description: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

spells.name: Move Quick
spells.description: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

spells.name: Toxic Shot
spells.description: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Noxious Trap
spells.description: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.description: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Arcanopulse
spells.description: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

spells.name: Eye of Destruction
spells.description: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

spells.name: Shocking Orb
spells.description: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

spells.name: Rite of the Arcane
spells.description: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

passive.name: Way of the Wanderer
passive.description: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased. Additionally, Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion or monster.

spells.name: Steel Tempest
spells.description: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne.Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.description: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Sweeping Blade
spells.description: Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases subsequent dash's damage, up to a max amount.Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds.If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.

spells.name: Last Breath
spells.description: Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm.For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.

passive.name: Crimson Pact
passive.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

spells.name: Transfusion
spells.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

spells.name: Sanguine Pool
spells.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

spells.name: Tides of Blood
spells.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

spells.name: Hemoplague
spells.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

passive.name: Echoing Flames
passive.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

spells.name: Corrosive Charge
spells.description: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

spells.name: Purge
spells.description: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

spells.name: Disdain
spells.description: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

spells.name: Fear Beyond Death
spells.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

passive.name: Cultivation of War
passive.description: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions  grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

spells.name: The Darkin Glaive
spells.description: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.

spells.name: Dreaded Return
spells.description: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.

spells.name: Aureate Rush
spells.description: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.

spells.name: Grim Deliverance
spells.description: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

passive.name: Cell Division
passive.description: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets. Each bloblet has a percentage of Zac's maximum Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. This ability has a 5 minute cooldown.

spells.name: Stretching Strikes
spells.description: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

spells.name: Unstable Matter
spells.description: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.

spells.name: Elastic Slingshot
spells.description: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

spells.name: Let's Bounce!
spells.description: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.

passive.name: Feline Friendship
passive.description: Periodically, when Yuumi strikes a champion with an attack or ability, she restores health to herself and the next ally she Attaches to.While Attached, Yuumi generates a special bond with her allies. The ally with the strongest bond enhances Yuumi's abilities while she is Attached to them.

spells.name: Prowling Projectile
spells.description: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally.While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period.

spells.name: You and Me!
spells.description: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets. While on her Best Friend, she gains Heal & Shield Power and grants her Ally On-Hit healing.

spells.name: Zoomies
spells.description: Shields Yuumi and boosts Move Speed and Attack Speed. If she's attached, she passes it to her ally instead.

spells.name: Final Chapter
spells.description: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies. Yuumi can move, attach, and cast Zoomies! while channeling. While on her Best Friend, this spell also follows her mouse.

passive.name: Clean Cuts
passive.description: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.

spells.name: Double Daggers
spells.description: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.

spells.name: Deadly Plumage
spells.description: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.

spells.name: Bladecaller
spells.description: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.

spells.name: Featherstorm
spells.description: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.

passive.name: Vow of the First Lands
passive.description: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Cultivation of Spirit
spells.description: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
spells.description: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.

spells.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
spells.description: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.

spells.name: Transcend One's Self
spells.description: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.

passive.name: Determination
passive.description: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

spells.name: Three Talon Strike
spells.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

spells.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
spells.description: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.

spells.name: Audacious Charge
spells.description: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.

spells.name: Crescent Guard
spells.description: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.

passive.name: Way of the Hunter
passive.description: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.

spells.name: Mortal Steel
spells.description: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.

spells.name: Spirit Cleave
spells.description: Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe.Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed.

spells.name: Soul Unbound
spells.description: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.

spells.name: Fate Sealed
spells.description: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.

passive.name: Contempt for the Weak
passive.description: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.

spells.name: Razor Shuriken
spells.description: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

spells.name: Living Shadow
spells.description: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability.Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

spells.name: Shadow Slash
spells.description: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.

spells.name: Death Mark
spells.description: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.

passive.name: Living Battery
passive.description: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Moving and casting Burst Fire stores up energy in Zeri's Sparkpack. When fully charged her next Attack deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Burst Fire
spells.description: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.

spells.name: Ultrashock Laser
spells.description: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit. If the pulse hits a wall it expands into a long range laser.

spells.name: Spark Surge
spells.description: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies. She will vault and grind over any terrain she touches.

spells.name: Lightning Crash
spells.description: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.

passive.name: Short Fuse
passive.description: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

spells.name: Bouncing Bomb
spells.description: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

spells.name: Satchel Charge
spells.description: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

spells.name: Hexplosive Minefield
spells.description: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.

spells.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
spells.description: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away.

passive.name: Shepherd of Souls
passive.description: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Last Rites
spells.description: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

spells.name: Dark Procession
spells.description: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

spells.name: Mourning Mist
spells.description: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.

spells.name: Eulogy of the Isles
spells.description: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

passive.name: More Sparkles!
passive.description: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Paddle Star!
spells.description: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

spells.name: Spell Thief
spells.description: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

spells.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
spells.description: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

spells.name: Portal Jump
spells.description: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.
